name.description: Official government name of the route, e.g. 'Skilled Worker visa'

status.description: draft = not yet publicly shown, missing tier-1 sourcing or incomplete. closed = route no longer accepts new applicants; kept in the dataset for historical/search reference rather than deleted.

superseded_by.description: Route id of the successor route, if status is 'closed' and a direct successor exists. Required (may be null) when status is 'closed'.

closed_date.description: Date the route stopped accepting new applicants. Required when status is 'closed'.

verified_at.description: Date this route's data was last checked against source. Fails validation past 180 days, warns past 90.

qualifying_event.description: For routes based on historical facts rather than testable current attributes (e.g. persecution-based citizenship restoration)

third_party_fees.description: Mandatory fees payable to a non-government party (endorsing bodies, degree-verification services, etc.) as a condition of the route. Separate from government application fees, which are not yet a formal schema field and live in notes.

sponsorship_duration_months.description: null = sponsorship (if any) required for the full route duration, the normal case. A number means sponsorship is only required for the first N months, after which the holder is unsponsored (e.g. UK Scale-up: 6). This is a partial fix for routes whose sponsorship model doesn't fit a single job_offer_status requirement cleanly.

requirement_groups.description: OR logic between groups. Each group is AND logic internally. One route can be qualified for via any one group.

outcome_override.description: Partial Outcome fields that differ for applicants qualifying via THIS group specifically, overriding the route-level Outcome. Only include fields that actually differ; unlisted fields inherit the route-level value. This is the fix for the recurring gap where Outcome was bound to Route when it actually varies by RequirementGroup (first surfaced on uk_global_talent and uk_ilr).

prerequisites_override.description: Partial prerequisites fields that differ for this group specifically, overriding the route-level prerequisites.

attribute.description: Must be one of the closed list of ~26 applicant attributes, e.g. 'current_salary', 'age', 'nationality'

value.description: EITHER a literal value (string/number/array/object for simple cases), OR a formula object referencing a NationalVariable for values that are a ratio of a periodically-updated reference figure (e.g. Germany's Blue Card salary threshold, pegged to the pension contribution ceiling). Formula shape: { "value_type": "formula", "formula_ref": "<national_variable id>", "ratio": <number>, "resolved_amount": <number, the current computed value for display>, "currency": "<ISO code>" }. The validator cross-checks resolved_amount against formula_ref/ratio if a matching national-variables file exists for the route's country.

hard.description: true = disqualifying if not met. Hard requirements MUST cite a tier-1 source.

blocker_text.description: Plain-language explanation shown if this isn't met

fix_path.description: What would change this. null if unfixable (e.g. age, nationality).

switchable_to.description: route ids this can convert to in-country without leaving
